summary: The audit checks at least 35 units, 26 or more of them Law School courses, and the required SPILS courses, including both quarters of the SPILS Master's Thesis (LAW 8012). Checked by hand: no more than 45 units taken at Stanford (for credit or not), electives your teaching fellow approves, at most 9 units elsewhere in the University and no language courses for law credit, the thesis and its public presentation, and three quarters in residence. All coursework must be done at Stanford.
